name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolariz
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolarizing error 0.0085 on single-qubit gates and 0.0383 on CX. Run a 3-qubit GHZ circuit with 8192 shots and compare noisy vs ideal counts. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
